waivers.rationale: A prediction sits on a surface that is not direct mathematical manipulation, and no manipulation follows within three steps. After deriving DIRECT from the engine capability registry this class fell from 292 to 161, and the residue is real signal rather than lint drift: 68 are on manip-0 answer-entry surfaces (numeric 37, mcq 31) and 93 are on manip-1 arrangement surfaces (matchPairs 29, dragBucket 21, dragOrder 18, buildExpression 9, steppedReveal 6, placeCompare 4, rationalCompare 3, exactNumberLab 2, absValueLine 1). It belongs to Wave 5 (gold pedagogy pilot) and Wave 11 (adaptive misconception program), where the pedagogy owner is in the loop per family.
